findingClass: a due PENDING ipo_field_plan row on a live IPO whose last attempt never advances: claimNextDueField hands it to every walk first (pri 0), the walk drops the write (field-plan-walk.ts dropped-write branch leaves state, attempts and last_attempt_at untouched) and puts it back, forever. Found 2026-09-25 on staging: 25 gmp_records.gmp rows on live IPOs, write dropped as MISSING_ROW_KEY on every wake
whatItAsks: every unclaimed, due PENDING plan row on an UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED IPO created 2+ slot boundaries ago has a last_attempt_at within the last two slot boundaries (isStrandedPendingRow, scripts/lib/field-plan-slot.mjs)
alarmsWhen: any non-zero; each row named by IPO slug, table.field and plan row id
scope: ipo_field_plan state PENDING, claimed_at NULL, IPO status UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED, every table and field, prod + staging slots
consumerReason: a stranded row is a per-row structural fact that stays until the write path or the plan row changes, so the same diffing consumer as pull_plan_stuck_reclaim reads it by identity
